design_gotchas.title: Non-M3 OPN Ships Either Legacy Bipolar or New CMOS Silicon
design_gotchas.detail: Per Table 8-1 (p.30), ordering LP2985-33DBVR (without M3) can supply either legacy silicon or redesigned new silicon. Key specs diverge dramatically: legacy has 45 dB PSRR, 280 mV dropout, 5 mOhm minimum ESR floor, 16 V abs max, and 205.4°C/W RθJA, while new chip has 78 dB PSRR, 180 mV dropout, 0-1 ohm ESR, 18 V abs max, and 1.12 uA shutdown current (100x higher typ than legacy 0.01 uA).

design_gotchas.title: TI Native LP2985 (SLVS522S) vs. National LP2985-N (SNVS018AB) Datasheet Split
design_gotchas.detail: The orderable OPN LP2985-33DBVR belongs exclusively to TI's SLVS522S datasheet (lp2985.pdf), not the legacy National Semiconductor LP2985-N datasheet (lp2985-n.pdf, which covers LP2985IM5-3.3/NOPB). Always verify parametric specs against SLVS522S.

design_gotchas.title: No Reverse-Current Protection — Body Diode Conducts When VOUT > VIN
design_gotchas.detail: Section 7.1.4 (p.21) warns that an intrinsic body diode conducts reverse current from VOUT to VIN if the output is held higher than input (e.g., during VIN short or backup-rail presence). Add an external Schottky diode across OUT-to-IN if reverse bias can occur.

design_gotchas.title: Ground Current Rises >10x Under Full 150 mA Load & High-VIN Thermal Limits
design_gotchas.detail: Although no-load IQ is ~69 uA, ground pin current climbs to 765-850 uA typ at 150 mA (p.6). Additionally, operating near 12 V-16 V VIN in SOT-23-5 (178.6-205.4°C/W) strictly limits continuous load current to ~35-50 mA at TA = 25°C before hitting TJ(max) = 125°C.

typical_use_cases: 12 V industrial or 2-3S battery to 3.3 V low-noise rails up to 150 mA (subject to thermal derating)
Low-noise analog, ADC reference, and RF stages leveraging Pin 4 10 nF bypass capacitor (30 uVRMS)
Candidate drop-in second source for standard SOT-23-5 BYPASS-pin LDO footprints requiring > 6 V VIN
General-purpose microcontroller standby rails with active-high ON/OFF control
engineering_summary: The TI LP2985-33DBVR is a 150 mA, 16 V max-VIN SOT-23-5 (DBV) LDO with a Pin 4 noise-bypass capacitor delivering 30 uVRMS output noise. It bridges 5.5 V CMOS LDOs and 30 V HV LDOs, making it a strong candidate drop-in for SOT-23-5 BYPASS footprints needing 12 V rail headroom. Engineers must account for mixed legacy-vs-new silicon shipments (PSRR 45 vs 78 dB, shutdown current 0.01 vs 1.12 uA, legacy 5 mOhm ESR floor) and verify SLVS522S ratings before production.

audit_notes: Resolved datasheet mismatch: confirmed LP2985-33DBVR is orderable in TI native lp2985.pdf (SLVS522S, p.33), not lp2985-n.pdf.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.3 confirmed DBV SOT-23-5 Top View pinout (1=VIN, 2=GND, 3=ON/OFF, 4=BYPASS, 5=VOUT) and no exposed pad.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.4 confirmed legacy (16 V abs max) vs new chip (18 V abs max) ratings, COUT >= 2.2 uF nominal, and 0-1 ohm new-chip ESR window.
